SELECT /* ========================= PRODUCT ========================= */
p.id AS id,
c.id AS campaign_id,
p.name AS name,
p.json_medias AS json_medias,
p.json_images AS json_images,
p.json_attributes AS json_attributes,
p.json_attributes_name AS json_attributes_name,

p.description AS description,
p.status AS status,
p.created_at AS create_at,
p.updated_at AS update_at, /* ========================= CAMPAIGN ========================= */
c.status AS campaign_status,
c.start_time AS campaign_start_at,
c.end_time AS campaign_end_at, /* ========================= SKU ========================= */ COALESCE( ( SELECT CONCAT( '[', GROUP_CONCAT( JSON_OBJECT( 'id', ps.id, 'sku_code', ps.sku_code, 'attribute', ps.attribute, 'type_product', ps.type_product, 'price', ps.price, 'stock', ps.stock, 'weight_gram', ps.weight_gram, 'length_cm', ps.length_cm, 'width_cm', ps.width_cm, 'height_cm', ps.height_cm, 'image_url', ps.image_url, 'status', ps.status, 'campaign_product_status', cp2.status, 'price_campaign', cp2.price, 'price_discount_campaign', cp2.price_discount, 'stock_campaign', cp2.stock_campaign ) ORDER BY ps.id SEPARATOR ',' ), ']' ) FROM campain_product cp2 INNER JOIN product_sku ps ON ps.id = cp2.sku_id AND ps.product_id = cp2.product_id WHERE cp2.campaign_id = c.id AND cp2.product_id = p.id AND cp2.is_deleted = 'false' AND ps.is_deleted = 'false' ), '[]' ) AS skus FROM campaign c
